rows.aerisApi: add_layout_series("bar_3d", { camera_3d }, { type: "points_3d", points: [{ x, y, z, label, color }], x_axis: { name, categories }, y_axis: { name, categories }, z_axis: { name }, size })
rows.supportedCombinations: At most 4,096 points per series; every 3D series of a pane shares one box and one camera; category values are indices; the pane scene holds at most 131,072 triangles
rows.differences: ECharts GL renders through WebGL with a depth buffer; Aeris sorts whole faces in the engine, so intersecting boxes from different series can order differently than per-pixel depth. Bar animation, realistic shading, post effects and calibrated visual review remain open.

rows.supportedCombinations: 2 to 128 strictly increasing positions per side; null heights leave holes; up to 9 color stops
